messages:
maria: FYI the pen-test PDF landed in the intake bucket. main callouts: 1) service-role has wildcard iam permissions, 2) staging KMS key is being used for prod-ish workflows, 3) several missing entries in audit logs for replayer service. link: s3://redwood-pt-intake/RT-2026-03/report.pdf :eyes:

sam: thanks — can you paste the vuln IDs we'll triage first? also need to schedule a remediation dry-run with ops before we open the retest window.

maria: vuln ids: RT-01 (iam wildcard), RT-02 (kms wrong key), RT-05 (audit gaps). putting short notes in the ticket: https://issues.redwood.ai/PT-842

kevin: quick KMS note — looks like staging key ARN got copied into the dedupe service config during a terraform change last month. will need key rotation + grant cleanups.

maria: @kevin can you estimate blast radius and time to rotate? we want a safe rollout plan that doesn't break consumers.

kevin: blast radius medium. rotation + grant update + smoke tests = ~3 hours dev, 2 hours staging, 1 hour prod window (with canary). fallback plan: re-add old grant for 15m if anything fails.

arjun: for RBAC, devs recreated a service-role to speed deploys. short term fix = remove "Action": "iam:*" for that role and scope to specific APIs. long term = immutable service roles per environment.

maria: agreed. adding remediation owners: RBAC -> arjun, KMS -> kevin, Audit -> tess. i'll create the remediation checklist and link to PT ticket.

tess: audit team will add missing events to the ingest pipeline and backfill 30 days. small question: do we prefer event-level or session-level logs for the replayer?

arjun: event-level for triage, session-level for analytics. we'll enable both but start with event-level to close the PT finding quickly.

maria: planning note: retest window request to vendor = 2026-04-02 to 2026-04-05. need evidence upload by 2026-04-01 EOD. can we meet that? :calendar:

kevin: rotation + grants + smoke tests done by 2026-03-30 if we start tomorrow. i'll post runbook snippet here.

kevin: ```
# quick rotation runbook
1. create new KMS key in prod account (alias: alias/pt-rotate-2026-03)
2. update service principal grants: kms:Encrypt,kms:Decrypt
3. update terraform state, apply in canary cluster
4. run smoke: ./scripts/smoke-kms.sh
5. rotate consumers in waves (10% -> 50% -> 100%)
```

maria: perfect. @deploy-bot please remind ops channel 1 hour before canary apply.

deploy-bot: Reminder scheduled: "KMS rotation canary apply" at 2026-03-29T14:00:00Z in #eng-oncall

sam: for remediation tracking I'll create a shortboard with 3 lanes (triage, remediating, evidence). linking here: https://kanban.redwood.ai/board/PT-842. please move items as you progress.

maria: also adding incident response hook: if rotation triggers >5% error rate, rollback and open incident channel. sam pls own oncall for the window.

sam: got it. i'll be oncall and will coordinate postmortem notes if we hit issues.

tess: audit backfill ETA 2 days after KMS rotation. i'll upload proof bundles (logs + query) to the evidence bucket. format: evidence/<PT-ID>/<component>/proof.json.gz

maria: final checklist before retest:
- RBAC tightened and PR merged (owner: arjun)
- KMS rotated and grants validated (owner: kevin)
- Audit backfill + streaming enabled (owner: tess)
- Evidence uploaded to S3 (owner: tess)
- Dry-run smoke on staging + ops signoff (owner: kevin/sam)

arjun: will open PR this afternoon. tagging reviewers @maria @kevin. PR link: https://repo.redwood.ai/r/iam/PR-319

maria: thanks team — i'll update PT ticket and ping vendor to confirm retest slot once evidence lands. if anything blocks, drop updates here. :thumbsup:
